rationale: The repaired blind translation is source-faithful. It reconstructs the sub-gaussian class through the single-scale square-exponential condition, faithfully expands the source's reference to equivalent properties i-iv while excluding the centered fifth criterion, and reconstructs the psi_2 norm as the infimum of exactly the positive admissible scales. Explicit measurability, integrability, ENNReal representation, and conditional finiteness make implicit source conventions formal without strengthening or weakening the definition.
